notes:
Summary: Closed-lost due to failed security review + unwillingness to share attestations. InfoSec would not accept redacted artifacts; required full SOC2 Type II report and ISO27001 cert. Account went quiet after decision to select competitor who could produce end-customer evidence and had an on-prem appliance.

Timeline / recent activity (bullets):
- 2025-09-10: Lead created via webinar (Marina). Initial discovery call scheduled.
- 2025-11-02: Discovery call w/ Head of AI (J. Morales) + InfoSec intro. They call out low-latency support for reranking and embedding throughput.
- 2025-11-18: Demo w/ SE (Ethan) — showed private deployment architecture and kv-cache/latency numbers.
- 2025-12-05: InfoSec checklist shared (SOC2 Type II, ISO27001, pen-test report, KMS integration, audit log retention).
- 2026-01-10: Submitted architecture + security FAQ (see Drive). Provided SOC2 summary but not raw report; proposed NDA to share redacted items.
- 2026-01-15: Deep technical review call (FF-2026-01-15-verdigris-demo-12345). InfoSec pushed back: redacted SOC2 insufficient, need evidence of customer-scoped pen-test and raw audit logs.
- 2026-01-29: Follow-up — asked for escalation; offered Dedicated with encrypted KMS and extended logging retention.
- 2026-02-12: Final decision meeting. Verdigris selects competitor (Anthropic Cloud) citing: full SOC2 Type II package, ISO27001 cert, and willingness to share customer-facing pen-test evidence.
- 2026-02-20: Last outreach (Marina) — account marked closed-lost.

Security review details / gaps noted by InfoSec:
- SOC2: only summary letter provided; they require full Type II report and auditor findings (won't accept high-level summary).
- ISO27001: Redwood cannot provide cert for our hosted environment mapping to Verdigris required residency; competitor had cert + mapped controls.
- Pen-test: Verdigris wanted vendor to redact customer-identifying details; InfoSec insisted on full report or auditor attestation at customer scope.
- Data residency: requested EU residency for a subset of workloads; private deployment plan required clarifications around VPC peering and key ownership.

Customer quotes / paraphrases from calls:
- "We need the auditor paperwork, not marketing slides." — Head of InfoSec.
- "If you can't show the pen-test scope and findings, we can't proceed with procurement." — Procurement director.

Why we lost / root cause analysis (short):
- Failure to share required third-party evidence (SOC2 Type II full report and pen-test) within timeline.
- Verdigris has low tolerance for redactions; competitor provided full artifacts and an on-prem option.
- Internal champion lost momentum (team restructure + hiring freeze).

Playbook / next steps (internal):
- Mark account closed-lost; record competitor win and security objections in CRM.
- Follow-up in 6 months to check if SOC2/ISO evidence can be made available or if on-prem packaging is viable.
- SE note: prepare tailored bridge doc explaining what can be shared under NDA and propose a customer-scoped attestation template.
- Open Jira RED-8471 to track request for improved evidence-pack for future procurement cycles.

Attachments / links: architecture + security FAQ in Drive; Fireflies call link for 2026-01-15 deep review; Gmail thread for procurement negotiation.

Short notes/fragments for AE:
- "Lost to Anthropic — had certs + pen-test."
- "No SOC2 full report -> InfoSec fail."
- "Budget hiring freeze contributed; re-engage later."
